privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This page explains how the Wedding Decision Platform handles guest data — the people you're inviting, not just the account holders.
privacy.whatBody: Names, home city and country, and whether a guest is a child, for anyone you add as a guest or household member — collected so the app can show travel distance, group sizes and venue costs across your guest list.
privacy.whyHeading: Why this is allowed without asking each guest
privacy.whyBody: Guests don't create accounts or consent individually. We rely on legitimate interest: you're planning a wedding, this data is necessary for that, and it's used only inside your project — never sold, shared with venues automatically, or used for anything else.
privacy.deletionBody: Deleting a guest, a household, or the whole project permanently removes the corresponding data — deleting a project removes every guest record in it, with nothing retained afterward.
privacy.contactBody: If you have questions about data handled in your project, contact the couple who created it — they control what's stored and can delete it at any time.
